Consider the graph of $y=f(x)$ above. Which of the following statements is true?
feedback.worked_solution:
From the graph, we see that

- The slope of the tangent at $x=-2$ is zero, so ${f}^{′}(-2)=0.$

- The slope of the tangent at $x=2$ is positive, so ${f}^{′}(2)>0.$

- The slope of the tangent at $x=5$ is negative, so ${f}^{′}(5)<0.$

Therefore, ${f}^{′}(5)<{f}^{′}(-2)<{f}^{′}(2).$
